project_specification.project_name: nullius — live evaluation pipeline (orchestrator member, spec A of the campaign driver)
project_specification.addition_summary: Add a new workspace member, packages/orchestrator (import name orchestrator). It is the orchestrator of docs/nullius-tech-architecture.md (app_spec feature 150), and it evaluates one live node with a single call. Today evaluation is a chain of separate evaluator verbs: resolve_window, execute_signal, normalize_scores, align_targets, gate_targets, apply_costs, compute_node_metrics, compute_marginal_ir and persist_node. Only tests/e2e/test_momentum_signal_positive_ic.py assembles them, and four pieces a live run needs are missing: - No implementation exists of the evaluator's TreeNodeWriter and ArtifactWriter protocols. - No caller of evaluator.debit_trial exists. - No way exists to hand the evaluator a null-aware oracle for a node below its campaign's root: the null target route answers NOT_FOUND for any node the sidecar does not hold, and Type-R seals roots only. - Nothing loads the evaluation inputs from configuration. This spec supplies those pieces, plus a one-call evaluate_node, without editing the evaluator, nulloracle or ledger members. Those are the read-only trust zone Z0, which the orchestrator calls and never changes. Spec B (additions_spec_campaign_driver.xml) builds the campaign loop on top of it.

existing_context.stack: Python 3.12 / uv-workspace (members = packages/*, picked up automatically) / Polars / SQLite or PostgreSQL via DATABASE_URL / pytest (ruff conventions)
existing_context.test_baseline: Measured 2026-10-05 on main (HEAD eb878ba): workspace tests/ 1594 passed; packages/providers/tests 1382, packages/signal-agent/tests 761, packages/dreaming/tests 787, packages/discovery/tests 678 passed.
existing_context.conventions:
Follow CLAUDE.md's Build & Test section and its rules: - Members only. Do not edit the root pyproject.toml, because the packages/* glob already registers a new member. - @register builders live only in a member's __init__.py. - Components are read through create_app().get(name). - A refusal is a typed error that opens with a greppable code word and is defined in the raising module. - Tests never reach the network or read a real credential.
Existing pieces (read, never edit): - The evaluator's canonical chain is in tests/e2e/test_momentum_signal_positive_ic.py::_run_pipeline. Mirror its inputs and order exactly. - resolve_window(snapshot, t) and execute_signal(resolution, code, *, seed, rebalance_dates=None, sandbox=None, materialize=None). - align_targets(execution, closes), and gate_targets(alignment, oracle, *, node_id, campaign_id, depth), where Oracle is a callable OracleRequest(node_id, campaign_id, depth, horizon, symbols, date_range) -> OracleResponse(target_series, charges_budget). - apply_costs(gated, charges, *, node_id, cost_model) and compute_node_metrics(returns, scores) -> NodeMetrics. - compute_marginal_ir(returns, book). - persist_node(*, node_id, campaign_id, snapshot_name, evaluator_hash, returns, metrics, profile, estimate, attribution, marginal, artifact_writer, tree_writer, code=None, steps_completed, database_url) -> NodePersistence. - The protocols TreeNodeWriter.write_node(node_row: NodeRow) -> (str, bool) (in evaluator._persist_store), and ArtifactWriter.write_artifact(node_id, campaign_id, filename, payload) plus flush(node_id) (in evaluator._artifact). - evaluator._debit: TrialCharge, charge_failure(...) and debit_trial(charge, ledger) -> DebitedTrial. ledger is the "ledger" component (TrialLedger.debit, idempotent by node). A charge carries node_id, campaign_id, outcome, charges_budget, epoch_id, evaluator_hash, snapshot_hash, cost_model_hash and charge_units. - nulloracle: - TargetEndpoint.post(TargetRequest(node_id, campaign_id, depth, horizon, symbols, date_range)) -> TargetResponse(status, node_id, target_series, charges_budget, detail). Status NOT_FOUND means the sidecar holds no entry for the node. - The Type-D flip is decided through the endpoint's past_flip seam, from the request. - TypeRSelection.persist(campaign_id) seals root assignments, and TypeRSelection.null_status(node_id) walks parent_id. - Components "nulloracle-target-route" and "nulloracle-type-r-selection". - The node table (migrations 0118, 0114 to 0117): the metric columns are ic_mean, ic_tstat, ir_standalone, ir_marginal, turnover, cost_adjusted_ir and perturb_stability. A node row is written first by discovery's AttemptLog, or by spec B's root planter. - signal_agent.ScoreRecord(ic_mean, ic_tstat, ir_standalone, ir_marginal, turnover, cost_adjusted_ir, perturb_stability, fail_class). - The artifacts member's ArtifactStore is the per-node artifact store.

category.name: Orchestrator Member
category.feature: System creates the orchestrator workspace member at packages/orchestrator (project name orchestrator, import name orchestrator). Its pyproject declares workspace dependencies on evaluator, nulloracle, ledger, artifacts, discovery, signal-agent, providers and policy-runtime, each with a [tool.uv.sources] workspace = true entry. It adds no third-party package. - uv.lock is regenerated with `uv lock`, and `uv sync --all-packages` succeeds. The root pyproject.toml is not edited. - orchestrator/__init__.py holds a module docstring and an empty __all__, and registers no component yet. - test_member.py imports orchestrator and asserts that create_app() still composes.

System creates a null-aware OracleResponse for any node of a campaign with orchestrator._oracle.SubtreeOracle(endpoint, *, database_url). This is a callable evaluator Oracle, OracleRequest -> OracleResponse. - It resolves the request node's root by walking node.parent_id in the DATABASE_URL store, until parent_id is NULL. - It posts TargetRequest(node_id=root id, campaign_id, depth=request.depth, horizon, symbols, date_range) to the endpoint. The root's sealed assignment therefore covers its whole subtree, as Type-R inheritance requires. Because the request keeps the node's own depth, the endpoint's Type-D past_flip still decides the flip by depth. - An OK response is mapped to OracleResponse(target_series, charges_budget). - Any other status raises OracleTargetError (code word oracle_target), carrying the status and the endpoint's detail. A node with no row, or a parent chain longer than 10000 links, raises OracleTargetError. - The module never reads a node's null bit, and never imports the sidecar key. Tests use a fake endpoint that records requests, and assert that children of a root are served under the root's id with their own depth.

System persists a node's evaluated metrics onto its existing node row with orchestrator._tree_writer.NodeMetricsWriter(database_url), an implementation of the evaluator's TreeNodeWriter protocol. - write_node(node_row) UPDATEs ic_mean, ic_tstat, ir_standalone, ir_marginal, turnover, cost_adjusted_ir and perturb_stability on the row whose id is node_row.node_id. It answers (node_id, written), where written is True when the row changed. - Writing the same values again answers written False. Different values for a row that already holds metrics raise NodeMetricsConflictError (code word node_metrics_conflict). - A missing node row raises NodeMetricsConflictError naming the node. The writer never INSERTs a node row. - Tests use a throwaway SQLite database migrated with the node table migrations.

System saves to the artifacts member's store every evaluation artifact of a node, with orchestrator._artifact_writer.ArtifactStoreWriter(store), an implementation of the evaluator's ArtifactWriter protocol. - write_artifact(node_id, campaign_id, filename, payload) stages the payload under the node, and flush(node_id) writes the staged files through the ArtifactStore. - Flushing a node with nothing staged is a no-op. Flushing twice rewrites nothing. - Tests use an ArtifactStore over a tmp_path directory.

System creates the live evaluation inputs with orchestrator._context.load_evaluation_context(env=None). It answers an EvaluationContext, or None when NULLIUS_EVALUATION_CONFIG is unset. - NULLIUS_EVALUATION_CONFIG names a JSON file holding snapshot_mount (a path), evaluation_dates (ISO dates), horizon, seed, epoch_id, artifact_dir and sandbox_runtime. - sandbox_runtime is "gvisor" or "unisolated". "gvisor" requires the runsc binary on PATH when the config loads. Without it, loading raises EvaluationConfigError naming isolation_required. "unisolated" is accepted only when the file also holds acknowledge_unisolated: true. Any other value, or "unisolated" without the acknowledgement, raises EvaluationConfigError. There is no default: a missing key is refused. - The other inputs come from the variables the members already read: DATABASE_URL, NULLIUS_COST_MODEL_PATH, NULLIUS_EVALUATOR_CONFIG and the null sidecar's own variables. - EvaluationContext is a frozen dataclass. It holds the snapshot handle and closes, the cost schedule and cost model, the evaluator identity (evaluator_hash, snapshot_hash, cost_model_hash), the epoch_id, the database_url, the artifact directory, and the seed. It builds exactly the inputs _run_pipeline assembles. - A missing file, a missing key, or an epoch_id that is not a non-blank string raises EvaluationConfigError (code word evaluation_config) naming the key. The file never holds a credential.

System persists one evaluated node's debit to the trial ledger with orchestrator._charge.charge_node(node_id, campaign_id, *, outcome, charges_budget, epoch_id, evaluator_hash, snapshot_hash, cost_model_hash, ledger), and it answers the evaluator's DebitedTrial. - It builds the evaluator's TrialCharge with all nine terms, and calls evaluator.debit_trial(charge, ledger). - charge_failed_node(node_id, campaign_id, failure, *, ...) uses evaluator.charge_failure for a node whose evaluation failed, with the same terms. - A second charge for the same node answers the ledger's existing record, so it is idempotent by node. - charges_budget is passed exactly as the oracle answered it, and is never recomputed. - Tests use a TrialLedger over a throwaway SQLite database.

System evaluates one live node with orchestrator._evaluate.evaluate_node(node_id, campaign_id, depth, code, *, context, oracle, ledger), and it answers a NodeEvaluation with node_id, metrics, score (a signal_agent.ScoreRecord), charges_budget, fail_class, persistence and debit. - Before anything executes, the code is screened against the sandbox member's committed import allowlist (sandbox.SandboxImports, the IMPORTS_COMPONENT_NAME component). A disallowed import is charged with charge_failed_node, with fail_class disallowed_import, and the code is never executed. - When context.sandbox_runtime is "unisolated", each evaluation logs one WARNING line, "unisolated sandbox", naming the node. - It runs the evaluator chain in _run_pipeline's order: resolve_window, execute_signal, normalize_scores, align_targets, gate_targets (with the SubtreeOracle), apply_costs, compute_node_metrics, and compute_marginal_ir against an empty book. - It then calls persist_node with NodeMetricsWriter and ArtifactStoreWriter, and charges the node with charge_node. - When the signal raises, or the sandbox or the execution fails, the node is charged with charge_failed_node. NodeEvaluation then carries fail_class (the failure's class name) and no metrics, and nothing is retried. - The score is ScoreRecord(ic_mean, ic_tstat, ir_standalone, ir_marginal, turnover, cost_adjusted_ir, perturb_stability=None, fail_class). Evaluating the same node twice answers the same metrics, appends no second debit and writes no conflicting row. - The module never reads a null bit. charges_budget comes only from the oracle's response. - Tests reuse the momentum e2e test's fixture approach (a seeded snapshot and closes) with a fake endpoint.

System creates a "live-evaluator" component, registered with @register in orchestrator/__init__.py. Its builder answers a LiveEvaluator whose evaluate(node_id, campaign_id, depth, code) calls evaluate_node with the loaded context, a SubtreeOracle over the "nulloracle-target-route" component, and the "ledger" component. It answers None when load_evaluation_context() answers None. - The builder reads only NULLIUS_EVALUATION_CONFIG and the variables named in feature 5. It evaluates nothing at build time. - The package exports evaluate_node, NodeEvaluation, LiveEvaluator, SubtreeOracle, OracleTargetError, NodeMetricsWriter, ArtifactStoreWriter, load_evaluation_context, EvaluationContext, EvaluationConfigError, charge_node and charge_failed_node in __all__.

category.name: Evaluation Verification
category.feature: System verifies live evaluation end to end with no network in tests/e2e/test_live_evaluation_end_to_end.py. - Setup: a campaign with two roots and one child each is seeded in a throwaway SQLite database, with a seeded snapshot. TypeRSelection.persist(campaign_id) seals the roots into a throwaway sidecar so that one root is null and one is real, and the test fixture controls which through the selection's seed. - evaluate_node runs on both children through a SubtreeOracle over a real TargetEndpoint. - The test asserts that each child's metrics land on its node row, and that each child is debited once on the ledger with the oracle's charges_budget. - It asserts that the null root's child was served the permuted target and the real root's child the real one. It checks this from the endpoint's responses, and never from a null bit inside the orchestrator. - A second evaluate_node on the same child appends no second debit. - A child whose signal raises is charged as a failure, with its fail_class.

project_specification.integration_points: The new member is packages/orchestrator, with the private modules _oracle, _tree_writer, _artifact_writer, _context, _charge and _evaluate, and the component "live-evaluator". Features 1 and 8 are the only edits to orchestrator/__init__.py. Feature 1 is the only edit to uv.lock. The evaluator, nulloracle, ledger, artifacts and discovery members are called, never edited. Every new file is committed as an empty stub so its claim resolves. Spec B adds root planting, live selection and the campaign loop to the same member.
project_specification.constraints: - Do not edit the evaluator, nulloracle, ledger, artifacts or discovery members, the migrations, or the root pyproject.toml. Z0 is called, never changed. - The orchestrator never reads a node's null status, the sidecar key or any is_null value. Null-ness reaches evaluation only as the target series and charges_budget the null target route answers. - Every evaluated node, failed ones included, is debited exactly once with all nine terms. - Model-written code never executes before the import screen. Live evaluation refuses to start without sandbox_runtime "gvisor" (runsc on PATH), or an explicit "unisolated" acknowledgement in the config. A gVisor executor is a later spec. - No test opens a network connection or reads a real credential. No third-party dependency is added. - Do not edit run.sh, the .env templates, claw-forge.yaml or docs/user-journeys/. - All existing workspace tests (tests/) and the member suites of evaluator, nulloracle, ledger, discovery, signal-agent and providers stay green.

implementation_steps.step: Phase 2: the oracle adapter, the two writers, the context and the charge (features 2 to 6), in parallel.
Phase 4: the component (feature 8) and the end-to-end verification (feature 9).
